# International Women's Media Foundation (IWMF)

> IWMF empowers women journalists globally through safety training, emergency assistance, fellowships, and research on gender equity in media.

The International Women's Media Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting women journalists and advancing press freedom worldwide. IWMF provides critical resources including journalist safety programs, emergency financial assistance, professional fellowships, and research on violence and harassment in newsrooms.

## Key Topics

- Women journalists
- Journalist safety
- Press freedom
- Gender equity in media
- Emergency assistance
- Fellowships and grants
- Trauma support
- Hostile environment training
- HEFAT (Hostile Environment & First Aid Training)
- Elizabeth Neuffer Fellowship
- Anja Niedringhaus Courage in Photojournalism Award
- Nonbinary journalists
- Media equity
- Journalism awards
- Safety training

## Core Mission & Focus

- [Home](https://www.iwmf.org): IWMF homepage featuring journalism awards, safety training, and fellowships for women journalists.
- [About IWMF](https://www.iwmf.org/about): International Women's Media Foundation mission, vision, and organizational values.
- [Our Focus](https://www.iwmf.org/focus): IWMF mission on journalist safety, emergency assistance, and media equity.

## Safety & Support Programs

- [Safety](https://www.iwmf.org/issues/safety): IWMF safety programs including Emergency Fund, therapy relief, and hostile environment training.
- [Self-Care and Trauma](https://www.iwmf.org/self-care-and-trauma): Journalist wellness resources including HEFAT trauma training and mental health support.

## Grants, Fellowships & Awards

- [Opportunity](https://www.iwmf.org/issues/opportunity): IWMF grants and fellowships including Howard G. Buffett Fund and Elizabeth Neuffer Fellowship.

## Research & Education

- [Research](https://www.iwmf.org/research): IWMF research on violence, harassment, and status of women in global news media.
- [Webinars](https://www.iwmf.org/webinars): IWMF webinar series on journalist safety, protest coverage, and pandemic reporting.

- [Board of Directors](https://www.iwmf.org/board-of-directors): IWMF board leadership including Suzanne Malveaux, Linda Douglass, and Jennifer Reingold.
- [Staff](https://www.iwmf.org/about/staff): IWMF staff directory featuring Elisa Lees Muñoz, Nadine Hoffman, and team members.
- [Donors](https://www.iwmf.org/about/donors): IWMF donors including Annenberg, Democracy Fund, Doris Duke, and Ford Foundations.
- [Contact Us](https://www.iwmf.org/about/contact-us): IWMF contact form and Washington, DC office location for support requests.

## News & Updates

- [News](https://www.iwmf.org/about/news): IWMF news, press releases, and updates on fellowships and women journalists.
